summary: Support common legacy String.prototype.substr used by older web/Electron code.

target.notes: Implement Annex B web-legacy substr: start uses ToIntegerOrInfinity with negative relative indexing; length is ToIntegerOrInfinity and non-positive yields empty string; end is clamped.

semantics.start: negative values count from end after coercion
semantics.length: omitted means through end; <=0 yields empty string

caveats: Annex B is web-legacy compatibility behavior; target hosts may choose not to expose it, but Electron/V8 compatibility generally requires it.
